messages.not_in_voice: You need to be in a voice channel first.
messages.get_player_not_in_voice: You need to be in a voice channel to use music commands.
messages.music_not_connected: Not connected to any music servers.
messages.music_voice_failed: I couldn't establish the voice connection. Try again in a moment.
messages.music_connected: Connected to a music server and ready.
messages.pause_nothing: There is nothing playing right now.
messages.stop_ok: Stopped playback and cleared the queue.
messages.disconnect_nothing: I am not connected to a voice channel.
messages.autoplay_on: Autoplay enabled — I'll queue similar tracks automatically.
messages.autoplay_unavailable: Autoplay is not configured (no Last.fm API key).
messages.loop_on: Loop enabled — repeating the current track.
messages.liked_empty: You haven't liked any songs yet — play something and use `.like` or the ♥ button on the music panel.
messages.unlike_nothing: You don't have any liked songs.
messages.unlike_invalid: That's not a valid like number — check `.liked`.
messages.music_start_failed: I couldn't start playback on the music server — please try `.play` again.
messages.music_db_error: Couldn't reach the music database right now — try again in a moment.
messages.music_playlist_capped: Only the first {count} tracks were added — playlists are capped to keep the queue manageable.
messages.dj_only: You need the DJ role to use that control.
messages.dj_manage_only: Only members with **Manage Server** can change the DJ role.
messages.dj_status_off: Playback controls are open to everyone. A manager can set a DJ role with `{prefix}dj role @role`.
messages.dj_status_on: Playback controls are DJ-only. DJ role: {role}.
messages.dj_role_set: DJ role set to {role} — only DJs and managers can skip, stop, loop, change the volume, or disconnect.
messages.dj_role_cleared: DJ role cleared — everyone can control playback again.
messages.dj_role_everyone: `@everyone` cannot be the DJ role, since it would restrict nobody.
messages.playlist_dm: Shared playlists live in a server, so use this command there.
messages.playlist_empty: No shared playlists yet. Start one with `{prefix}playlist create <name>`.
messages.playlist_created: Created **{name}**. Use the `playlist share` command to let others add tracks.
messages.playlist_exists: This server already has a playlist called **{name}**.
messages.playlist_name_invalid: Give the playlist a name of 1–60 characters.
messages.playlist_not_found: No playlist called **{name}** in this server.
messages.playlist_editor_only: Only this playlist's editors can change it.
messages.playlist_owner_only: Only the playlist's owner can delete it.
messages.playlist_remove_invalid: That is not a track number. Check `{prefix}playlist show <name>`.
messages.playlist_show_empty: **{name}** has no tracks yet. Play something, then use `{prefix}playlist add {name}`.
messages.playlist_shared: {member} can now add and remove tracks in **{name}**.
messages.playlist_add_nothing: Play something first, then add it with this command.
messages.activity_unavailable: The interactive player isn't available right now.
messages.panel_action_failed: The music server didn't respond — try again in a moment.
messages.panel_session_expired: The music server dropped this session — run `/play` to start the queue again.
messages.queue_ghost_header: -# 📻 **Autoplay suggestions** (play when the queue runs dry):

messages.scrobble_status_off: Last.fm scrobbling is **off** for you. Turn it on with `{prefix}scrobble on`.
messages.scrobble_enabled: Last.fm scrobbling is on. Tracks you request will be scrobbled to your linked account.
messages.scrobble_link_first: Link your Last.fm account on the website first, then turn scrobbling on.
messages.scrobble_unavailable: Scrobbling is not configured on this bot (missing LASTFM_API_KEY or LASTFM_API_SECRET).
messages.scrobble_save_failed: Could not save that setting. Try again in a moment.

commands.disconnect.help: Have niko leave the voice channel
commands.dj.help: Show or set the DJ role that guards playback controls
commands.djclear.help: Clear the DJ role so everyone can control playback
commands.playlist.help: Shared playlists: list, create, add the current track, play
commands.playlistadd.help: Add the current track to a shared playlist
commands.playlistplay.help: Queue every track in a shared playlist
commands.playlistremove.help: Remove a numbered track from a shared playlist
commands.playlistshare.help: Let a member add and remove tracks in a playlist
commands.loop.help: Toggle loop for the current track
commands.musicstatus.help: Check if niko is connected to a music server
commands.nowplaying.help: See what is playing right now
commands.play.args.search: Song name, YouTube/SoundCloud/Spotify URL, or sc:<query>
commands.play.description: Play a song or add it to the queue
commands.play.help: Play a song or queue it up
commands.unlike.help: Remove a liked song (use number from.liked)
commands.scrobble.help: Scrobble the tracks you request to your linked Last.fm account
